status: Dedicated exploratory stalk-protector pilot in preparation; no validated protector
initial_format: Monovalent de novo binder targeting Y488/P490/S491
parent_input: Independent stalk-targeted generation, not dependent on Ig1/Ig2 parents
mechanism_hypothesis: Occupy the MERTK cleavage-site region to obstruct protease access. Geometry is a hypothesis; cleavage inhibition must be measured.

reported_cleavage_context.role: Target for the separately authorized November 17 exploratory protector campaign
reported_cleavage_context.experimental_structure_limit: 37NT ends at G484; it does not directly show the cleavage bond

primary_screen: Compare each monovalent parent with matched nonbinding control under a declared shedding condition
Measure released soluble MERTK and intact surface MERTK together
Record total receptor and viability to distinguish preservation from loss of receptor or cells
confirmation: Use orthogonal receptor detection and test soluble-MERTK assay interference
Measure GAS6 and PROS1 function separately
Confirm MERTK-dependent apoptotic-cell internalization and useful repeated uptake
Exclude broad ADAM17 inhibition before attributing protection to MERTK-specific occupancy
format_integration: Dimerization and PS targeting are not prerequisites for the protection screen. Reassess protection, surface retention and uptake if a hit is later fused into a scaffold.
generation_ready: Conditional on frozen-input validation and a successful matched GPU preflight
previous_strategy: Screening shared Ig1/Ig2 parents produced no eligible parent; no protection was tested.
